title: Audio Playback Interface
text: Simulate audio output device on a hardware board, 1 input, 1 output; {Output}, {Number of channels} sets the number of data channels, {Samples per frame} sets the size of data vector read from audio device and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Audio data frame M -element vector | M -by- C matrix

params.name: Output
params.values: Output type To terminator (default) | To output port

params.name: Number of channels
params.values: Number of data channels 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Size of data vector read from audio device 4410 (default) | positive scalar integer

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time in seconds -1 (default) | positive scalar
